notes: WArmy 0.4.62 — Diwen updated to 6.16.4. The nm viewer opened from a reply's horse-head now lets you select text and right-click for Copy / Select All / Translate / Translate Whole Page (translations replace the original with a light theme-tinted background); fullscreen no longer turns white and restore works. Evolution replies' horse-head no longer errors with message-missing. Generated interactive cards no longer show overlapping icon-name text, and their buttons now really work: Open Folder / Open File open the path, Copy Path / Copy put text on the clipboard, and Dispatch sends the content to the workhorse. The approval-feedback card is kept; the model now judges typical preference examples itself and only occasionally sends them as system messages for you to label afterwards, with a self-improving cadence file. The message icon badge now counts only join requests plus important system messages (faults / exceptions / urgent); briefings and updates badge only inside the System Messages menu. Insert-template in workhorse cognition now applies reliably.
